deferredToContractItem: the exact exclusion reason vocabulary for the eligible universe accounting

binding.emissionOrder: all applicable reasons in precedence order
binding.datasetLevelIdentityOrBindingFailure: ENGINE_FAIL_CLOSED; never converted into a candidate exclusion reason

notes: The P3H exclusion class is read from P3H finalization exclusions[].reasonCode; a P3H exclusion cannot be re-presented as ADMITTED, and an exclusion class outside p3hClassMapping is dataset-level and fails closed.
OUTSIDE_HISTORICAL_WINDOW applies when sessionDate is outside the R0003 historicalObservationWindow or is not strictly before the query SessionDate T.
AVAILABLE_AFTER_KNOWLEDGE_CUTOFF applies when any selection or distance input cannot prove availableAt <= its own K(T_hist) and <= K(T), including an absent K(T_hist).
INSTRUMENT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH applies when the candidate identity was not resolved at its own session date or differs from the query identity.

REGIME_HORIZON_SPEC_MISMATCH, CORE_V1_REGIME_MISMATCH and VOLATILITY_STATE_UNAVAILABLE all apply when no GATE24 RegimeRecord is bound to the candidate; CORE_V1 matching is exact string equality of the six dimensions.

GATE23 feature status maps as: absent record, INSUFFICIENT_DATA, null value or FAIL_CLOSED code INPUT_MISSING to REQUIRED_DISTANCE_FEATURE_MISSING; any other FAIL_CLOSED or a non-number value to REQUIRED_DISTANCE_FEATURE_MALFORMED; a non-finite number to REQUIRED_DISTANCE_FEATURE_NON_FINITE.

A structurally invalid candidate, a candidate outside the bound pin set, a RegimeRecord whose identity does not recompute, a non-single-valued calendar binding, and duplicate or non-canonical candidate order are engine fail-closed conditions, never exclusion reasons.
